answer: Identities are as cheap as ocean water, so each newcomer needs a sponsor staking 50 credits to vouch for it, becoming a vertex in the referral graph. Reputation decays 10% each epoch unless renewed by verified work; a caught fake slashes the sponsor's stake too. Running 100 fakes locks 5,000 credits plus endless renewal, far above their earnings. An honest agent needs one sponsor and one stake, and the shared meadow stays open to real workers.
